<kitot>, quarrel, and <kiselna>, dispute: a pair of near synonyms said together for quarrelling and strife of every kind between people; often with <om>, there is, or <piangsak>, cause
of mountains and hills, be dug down flat
<kitot>, quarrel, and <lawh>, as a result, written as one word: come to quarrel because of what was named before
quarrelling over something, in the verse over the law
<kitot> quarrel with the noun suffix <na>: quarrelling and strife between people; {kitotna piangsak} is stir up strife
<kitotna> quarrel with the plural <te>
argue back and forth with one another, said together with <kikoko>, shout at one another
<kitot> quarrel, with <pih>, together with; {kitotpih pa} is the man one has a dispute with, an adversary
<kitotpih> contend with, with <pa>, the man: the man one has a quarrel or dispute with
<kitot>, quarrel, with its last part repeated: go on quarrelling with one another
town in the territory of Zebulun whose Canaanite inhabitants were not driven out
son of Javan and grandson of Japheth; also the people descended from him and their land, Cyprus
<tu>, sit, with the prefix <ki>: people sit, sit down together, also of a sitting or a sit-in
of cocks, fight each other; {ak kitu sak} is to set cocks fighting; inferred from one sentence and one dictionary entry
come together with someone, used with <tawh>
of two parts: meet and close on each other
move to live or work in another place, the place marked by <ah> or <pan>; not a meeting of persons or of parts as in the other senses
in {maitang kituahin} or {mai kituahin}, with faces meeting; <kituah> meet with the suffix <in>
<kituah> meet with the linking suffix <in>: meeting, coming together, and then
fall together, said of two days; <tuahkhak> with the reciprocal prefix <ki>
<kituah>, meet, with <khawm>, together, written as one word; {maitang kituahkhawm} is meet face to face
<kituah> and <loh>, not, written as one word before <man> or <manin>: not fitting or agreeing with something, which is marked by <tawh>
of goods and treasure, be seized and taken away
the meeting of persons or things, with <mun> the place where they meet
<kituahna> meeting place with the plural <te>; {lampi kituahnate} are the places where streets meet, the public squares
<kituah> meet with the ending <pih>: meet with someone or something on the way
the people one happens to meet; <kituahpih> with the plural <te>
be made to change place: of people, be moved to another place of stay or posting
<kituahsak>, be moved to another place, and <ding>, will, written as one word
of statements, thoughts or minds: agree with one another, be the same; {thu kituak lo} is disagree

terms: go well with/be compatible/be fitting/be suitable
definition: be right or suitable for someone or something; <tawh> marks what it fits
<ki> with <tuak>, meet: come upon a person, a thing or a hardship, not agree with or suit it; what is met stands before {kituak}, with or without <tawh>
<kituak> be fitting, with the linking ending <a>

terms: according to/in accordance with/in keeping with
definition: placed after <tawh>; <kituak> with the suffix <in>
<kituak> be fitting with the ending <in>: in a way that fits, rightly; {a kituakin a gen} is spoke rightly
<tuakkha>, come upon by chance, with the prefix <ki>: meet one another by chance, or of two events fall at the same time; <tawh> marks what is met

terms: coincide/happen at the same time/fit exactly
definition: <kituak>, match, and an ending that means exactly: fall at exactly the same time as something else or fit it exactly; <tawh> marks the other thing
<kituak> and <lo> written as one word: not agree with, not be in keeping with, not be proper
<kituak>, agree or fit, with <lohna>, written as one word: the fact or the point of not matching or not being suitable; {tawh kituaklohna} is what does not go well with something
the man who encountered something, in the verse robbers; <kituak> meet, with <pa> marking a man
<kituak>, be fitting, and <pen>, most, written as one word: the one that fits best; <tawh> marks what it fits
<kituak> agree or match, with the causative <sak>
<kituak> match, agree with, with the plural <te>: the things that agree with something
<kituak> and <thei>, can, written as one word: be able to fit or go well with something, which <tawh> marks
the amount that is fitting for someone; <kituak> be fitting, with <zah> amount
<kituak>, be fitting, and <zaw>, more, written as one word; <tawh> marks what it fits and <sangin> what it is compared with
<tuam> cover with the prefix <ki>: wrap or cover oneself, or be covered with something; {kituam nading} is a covering

terms: be kept apart/be set apart/be isolated
definition: <tuam.2>, separate, with <ki>: be put apart from the others, as a sick person or a traveller kept alone in {kituam koih} and {kituam kep}; {kituam bawlna} is treating people differently; nothing is wrapped
<tuamcip> cover completely with the prefix <ki>: be wrapped in something as in a cloak
<kituamcip> be wrapped up tight, with <sak>; said of sin
{Kituam}, be wrapped, with the linking ending <in>: being wrapped, as the hands and feet of a dead body in strips of cloth.
Passive of <tuamkoih>, set apart, with the prefix <ki>: be kept separate from the rest, as a share of land set aside for the Lord, or people who hold themselves apart from others.
{Kituam}, wrap oneself, with the noun suffix <na>: the cloth a person wraps or covers himself with, such as a cloak or a veil; {kituamna puan} is a garment wrapped around the body.
Passive of <tuancil>, trample, with the prefix <ki>: be trodden down under the feet, said of a vineyard, a crown, the sanctuary or grass.
<tuang>, ride, with the prefix <ki>: people ride or travel in a vehicle, said without naming who
{Tuangsakin}, making someone ride, with the passive prefix <ki>: couriers being put on horses, after which the next action follows.
<kituang>, ride or travel by, and <thei>, can, written as one word: people can travel by the vehicle named
<tuantual> with the prefix {ki-}: be behind others in progress, said of a people, a land or its affairs
<ki> with <tuat>: be worked out or estimated, or be regarded as something; {kituat zo lo} is beyond reckoning
<kituat>, be reckoned, with the noun suffix <na>: the way something is counted or calculated, as in {kum kituatna}, the reckoning of years
Passive of <tuh>, sow, with the prefix <ki>: of seed, be put into the ground; {khaici kituh} is seed is sown, and {a kituh} is what has been sown.
Strive against one another for something, as for a throne or in a case at law, or strive to be the first to do something.
of a dead body: be laid in the grave, an extended use of {kituh}, be planted; the place is named with <han> or <hanmual> followed by <ah>
{Kituh}, contend, with the linking ending <in>: disputing over something, which stands before the word.
{Kituh}, be sown, with the linking ending <in>: of a grain, being put into the ground before something else happens.
{Kituh}, be sown, with <kik>, again: of seed, be sown once more in land that lay waste.
{Kituh}, contend, with the noun suffix <na>: a dispute between people; {thu kituhna} is a dispute over a matter, a case at law.
{Kituhnate}, disputes, with the place ending <ah>: in matters that people contend over.
{Kituh}, be sown, with the plural <te>: the things that were sown; {khai kituhte} are the seeds that were sown.

terms: press in/strive eagerly for/force a way in
definition: Of many people, struggle eagerly to get hold of something or to get into it; probably <kituh>, contend, with an intensifying ending.
<kituh>, contend, doubled: go on struggling against one another for something, never satisfied
Passive of <tuiphum>, baptize, with the prefix <ki>; literally be immersed in water.
{Kituiphum}, be baptized, with the noun suffix <na>: the baptism that a person receives.
literally pour hot water over one another, from <ki>, <tuisa> and <buah>; the book lists it among its idiomatic expressions without explaining it, and the figurative sense is not known
Passive of <tuisak>, melt, with the prefix <ki>: said of metal made liquid in a furnace.
{Tuk}, fall, with the prefix <ki>: of a person, stumble and fall; of an idol, topple over.
of words, opinions or people, to cross each other and not agree
<kitukalh> and <lo> written as one word: not be at odds with one another
Mix up the speech or the minds of people so that they no longer understand one another or think clearly.
{Kituk}, stumble, with the noun suffix <na>: stumbling, or the thing that makes people stumble, as a stone in the way.

terms: be served to drink/be given to drink/be fed
definition: passive <ki> with <tulh>, give to drink: of drink at a feast, be served to the guests; of food, be put into the mouth of a child
push into a matter that is the business of others; used after <va>, go and
Passive of <tum>, blow, with the prefix <ki>: said of a trumpet or horn, or of the signal given with it.
hit one another with the fists, fight or box; no instrument is named, and words such as <kitawng>, punch one another, or {kisultuak} stand beside it
of a seal or stamp, be pressed on a document or a door; the word <seal> stands before {kitum}
{Kitum}, be blown, with the noun suffix <na>: the sounding of a trumpet.
Passive of <tumpih>, take in with one, with the prefix <ki>: of people or things, be led or carried into a place.
<tumsak>, have an instrument played, with the passive prefix <ki>: of an instrument, be given to someone to play; of a person, be made to play it
<tumsak>, let in, with the passive prefix <ki>: of a visitor, be allowed to enter
Be wrapped in cloth, as a baby in cloths or a dead body in grave clothes; also wrap oneself in something; the cloth takes <tawh> or the ending <in>.
Written {kitun’} in the phrase {ma kitun’}, make progress, be brought to success; from <tun>, arrive.
<ki> with <tun>, arrive: a person or thing is brought to a place or reaches it, after a place such as <zato>, hospital, or after <kiang> and <tung>; nothing is wrapped

terms: will be brought to/will be taken to
definition: <kitun>, be brought to a place, with <ding>, will, written as one word; {zum kitunding} is will be taken to court
Of a group of people, get as far as a place; <dong>, as far as, follows the place.
Of a noose or snare, be laid on the ground to catch someone.
Of a cloud of dust or smoke, rise into the air.
<kitung>, people arrive, and the linking <in> written as one word: having arrived at a place, and then

terms: arrive at once/get there right away
definition: <kitung>, arrive, and <pah>, at once, written as one word: people got to the place immediately, said of firemen and police reaching the scene
Passive of <tungsak>, bring to pass, with the prefix <ki>: said of vows that are carried out.
<kitung> and <ta> written as one word: people have now reached a place, a time or a situation
<ki> and <tungto> written as one word: a number or a people arrives at a point by going up, as cases that reach five million
{Kitun}, be wrapped, with the linking ending <in>: being wrapped in cloth; the cloth takes <tawh>.
{Kitun}, be wrapped, with the noun suffix <na>; {a kitunna puan} is the cloth in which a body was wrapped.

terms: be brought/be brought to/be led to
definition: Passive of <tunpih>, bring to a place, with the prefix <ki>: of people or things, be taken to someone or into a place.
{Kitun}, be wrapped, with <sa>, already, and the linking ending <in>: having been wrapped, said of a face bound with a cloth.
{Tunsak}, cause to arrive, with the prefix <ki>; in the verse it is said of idols that a person brings into sin.
of several people, come to the same place at the same time and so meet there, often without having planned it
Used in the phrase {maa kitunzo}, be able to reach the goal, succeed; <zo> is be able.
Strike each other with the fists, as boxers do; <tawh> marks the opponent.
<kitup>, fight with the fists, with the noun suffix {-na}: a fight or bout, and fighting as a sport; {kitupna pawi} is a fight event
<ki> and <tusak>, make sit, written as one word: be given a seat, seat oneself; of an aircraft, be made to land
Be brought to a place or handed over; {zum kitut} is take one another to court, and {kitut kik} is be brought back or restored.
{Kitut}, be brought, with <kik>, back: said of a land or people restored after war.
{Kitut}, be brought, with the noun suffix <na>; {galmatin a kitutna} is the place to which people were taken as captives.
<tutpih> with the prefix <ki>: sit together with someone, in the articles said of keeping a bereaved family company in the evening
of fowls, keep pecking at one another, a doubled verb for pecking with the prefix <ki>; a figure for people who do not live in peace
<tuu>, renew, with the prefix <ki>: of the validity of a card, be renewed; {tettan kituu sak} is have the validity renewed
The point where two sides or edges meet, as of a garment, a building or an altar; {kiu li} is the four corners.
Knock on a door to be let in; <kong> or <kongkhak>, door, stands before the word, and the form <kiuh> is used before <ciangin> and <leh>.
the joint of the arm, named together with other joints such as the knee and the shoulder when aches of the body are listed; not the corner of a thing
{Kiu}, corner, written with a capital in the names of parts of the wall of Jerusalem: {a Kiu} is the Angle, and {Kiu Kongpi} the Corner Gate.
Form of <kiu>, knock, used before <ciangin>, <leh> and similar words.
Intensifier placed after a verb or descriptive word: to the full, altogether; with <lo> it means not at all.
{Kiuhkeuh}, thoroughly, with the adverb ending <in>: completely, to the full, after a verb of ruin or of flourishing.
<kiuhkeuh>, utterly, and <lo>, not, written as one word after a verb: not in the least, not at all
<uk>, rule, with the prefix <ki>: be ruled, or rule oneself; {kiuk zia} is the system by which a country is governed, and {pumpi kiuk} is self-control
The corner of a building; {kiukawi bul suang} is the cornerstone.
Used after <uk> to describe a round hollow shape like a bowl or goblet.

placed after a describing word such as <neu> or <kawi>, or after <om>: pictures something small and compact or curled up, as a tiny dog, a little dot of light or a land tucked between others, not only the hollow of a bowl
<kiu> corner and <khat> one written as one word: one corner or side of something; {kiukhat pan} is from one side, from one point of view
Describes the crystal vault above the living creatures; whether it refers to the shine or to the arched shape is not confirmed.
placed after a verb in everyday writing: to a small degree, only just, as in {kong hong kiukiau}, the door a little open, and {i theih kiukiau}, the little that we know
<Kiu>, knock, said twice: knock again and again at a door.

terms: here and there/now and then/a few
definition: after <om>, be, {om kiukiu} says that something is found or happens in small numbers, one here and one there, not that anyone knocks
the way a country or people is governed; {gam kiukna} is the government of a country and {federal kiukna} a federal system

terms: system of government/form of government/way of governing
definition: <kiuk> and <zia> written as one word: the way a country is governed, a system of government such as democracy or federalism
<Kiu>, corner, with <li>, four: the four corners or quarters; {leitung kiuli} is the four quarters of the earth.
<um>, believe, with the prefix <ki>, written as one word: be believed; {kium mawh} is it is feared or suspected
be enclosed all round, as a place by a fence
Passive of <umcih>, besiege, with the prefix <ki>: be surrounded by an army; {kulhpi tawh a kiumcih khuapi} is a city surrounded with walls, a fortified city.
{Kiumcih}, be besieged, with the noun suffix <na>: the besieging of a city.
<ummawh>, suspect, with the prefix <ki>, written as one word: it is suspected or thought likely, of what is not known for certain; usually after {ding in}
<Kiu>, corner, with the plural <te>.
<Kiu>, knock, with the plural <te>; {a kiute} are the ones who knock at a door.
know a kind of work or subject well from practice, placed after the subject, often with <lam>; {kiva mahmah} is expert and {kiva lo} is not good at

terms: be fed/be provided for/get a living/be served
definition: {Vaak}, feed, with the prefix <ki>: feed oneself or be fed and supplied by others; {a kivaak nading} is what one has to live on.
the prefix <ki> with <vaak>, light: of lamps, torches or fires, be lit and give light, mostly as {kivaak zihziah}, lit up all over, in accounts of the Khuado festival; nothing to do with feeding
<kivaak> with the noun ending {-na}: what one lives on, the way one makes a living
passive of <vaihawm>, manage or arrange: of a matter or a need, be seen to and settled; {kivaihawm sak} is have it arranged for someone
passive of <vaihawmsak> with the prefix <ki>: be arranged or provided for someone
Passive of <vaikhak>, give an order or send word, with the prefix <ki>: be arranged or ordered beforehand.
<vaipuak>, responsibility, with the prefix <ki>: have duties assigned among the members, be organised and run; {kivaipuak zia} is the way a group is organised
the running of the affairs of a country, people or organisation; said together with <ki-ukna>, rule
the way in which a country, an organisation or a church is run and its offices are arranged; from <kivaipuak>, carry out the affairs, with <zia>, manner
Provide food for oneself, make a living; the food takes <in> or <tawh>, live on it, and {kivak nading} is what one has to live on.
Passive of <vak>, light, with the prefix <ki>: said of a lamp that is lit and gives light; {kivak suak} is be kept burning.
passive of <vaak>, feed: people are given a meal by a host, a school or a relief group, usually as {an kivak}, food is served; in {kivak}, live on, a person provides for himself
<ki> with <vak>, here walk about: of a group, go round from place to place, mostly as {kivak kawikawi}; nothing to do with food or light
{Kivak}, feed oneself, with the linking ending <in>: feeding oneself or others, or being nourished by something, which takes <tawh>.
{Kivak}, be lit, with the linking ending <in>: said of lamps that are alight.
the prefix <ki> with <vakkhia>, go out: people go out and about, said in general of what people do
{Kivak}, feed, with the noun suffix <na>: the giving out or taking of food, or the place of feeding; {nisim kivakna} is the daily distribution of food.
a natural ability or gift of a person, often paired with <siamna>, skill, and glossed in the articles with the English word talent; not the feeding of the other sense
<ki> and <vakpih>, lead about, written as one word: be taken around a place by others, as a person paraded through a town to shame
{Kivak}, be lit, with <suak>, continue: said of a lamp that keeps giving light.
be much alike or close to each other, said with <tawh>
Passive of <valh>, swallow, with the prefix <ki>; {kivalh tum} is be swallowed up completely.
Passive of <valhtum>, swallow up, with the prefix <ki>: be completely destroyed, said of a king and his people.

terms: be handled/be arranged/be taken care of
definition: of a matter or case: be looked after and arranged by someone on behalf of another; {kivan pih} is help with the handling of it; compare <vaan>
<vang>, with gaps, and the prefix <ki>: stand or happen with wide gaps between; the book gives it as the opposite of <kizing>
<kivan> with the noun suffix <na>: the looking after and arranging of matters for one another; paired with <kizopna> for contact and dealings between villages
<kivan>, be handled, and <pih>, for someone, written as one word: a matter or case is handled on behalf of someone, help is given with it
<kivan>, be handled, with <sak>, here for someone: a matter or case is taken care of on a person's behalf
Passive of <vat>, strike, with the prefix <ki>; {kivat tuk} is be struck down and fall.
<kiva> with the plural <te>: people who are versed or engaged in a field
Passive of <vattuk>, strike down, with the prefix <ki>: be cut down in battle.
Passive of <vawh>, sow, with the prefix <ki>: of seed or of a word, be sown; of land, be sown with seed.
Of a donkey, horse or ox, have a saddle, load or yoke put on its back.

terms: be named/be called/be given a name
definition: after <min>, name: a name is put on a person, place, group or event; {cih min kivawh} is be given the name of
{Kivawh}, be sown, with the linking ending <in>.
{Kivawh}, have something fastened on, with the linking ending <in>: said of a sheet let down with a rope tied at each corner.
<kiva> and <zaw> written as one word: more skilled or more capable than others
Said of the earth shaking; another spelling of <kivei>, sway.

terms: be neighbours/live next to each other/adjoin
definition: <veeng>, neighbour, with the reciprocal prefix <ki>: of people, live as neighbours; of fields, lie side by side
passive of <veh>, visit, with the prefix <ki>: someone in prison, in a detention camp or in hospital is visited; {kiveh thei} is can be visited
Be waved to and fro before the Lord, said of the part of a sacrifice presented as a wave offering; {a kivei sa-iik} is the breast that was waved.
Move to and fro, said of the earth quaking or of men hanging on ropes; {kivei suk kivei to} is swing down and up.
passive of <vei>, be sick with or be burdened by: of an illness or a trouble, be suffered by people, not a thing moving to and fro
of people, go round without arriving, or stay in the same state while years pass, with a length of time such as {kum 40 sung}
Passive of <veii>, wave, with the prefix <ki>; {a kiveii sa-iik} is the breast that was waved before the Lord as an offering.
<veina>, concern, with <ki> in its mutual meaning: concern that people feel for one another, named beside <ki-it>, love for one another
after <kum>, year, as {kum-kiveina}: the coming round of the year, the yearly return of a day that is kept
{Kivei}, swing, with <suk>, downward; paired with <kiveito> of men who swing down and up on ropes.
{Kivei}, swing, with <to>, upward; paired with <kiveisuk> of men who swing down and up on ropes.
Passive of <vel>, look over, with the prefix <ki>: be checked carefully or searched out.
<kivel>, be examined, with the noun suffix {-na}: a medical examination, or the place or department where patients are examined
{Kivel}, be examined, with <sak>: let someone examine one, said of a healed person who shows himself to the priest.
Said of disputes that are brought to an end by a ruling; in the verse it is followed by <sak>.
{Kiveng}, be settled, with <sak>: of disputes, be decided by the word of the priests.
{Vial}, encircle, with the prefix <ki>: of a snake or of roots, wind around something.
{Kivial}, wind around, with the intensifier <gawp>: said of roots that twist all around stones.
<vik>, swing, with the passive prefix <ki>: of a lamp or other thing held in the hand, be swung or waved to and fro
<vik>, swing, with <ki> in the sense one another: of two sides, come to blows or wrangle over a matter; follows <tawh>, with
Passive of <vil>, watch, with the prefix <ki>; {a kivil inn} is a house kept under guard.
Passive of <vom>, carry on oneself, with the prefix <ki>; {a kivom aite} are charms worn on the body.
<vua>, beat, with the prefix <ki>: hit one another, or with {nang leh nang} beat oneself
Passive of <vui>, bury, with the prefix <ki>: of a dead person, be laid in a grave; the place takes <ah>.
<kivui>, be buried, and <ding>, will, written as one word: of a dead person or the body, will be buried in the place named
<kivui>, be buried, and <khawm>, together, written as one word: be buried together with another person or with a thing

terms: be buried by mistake/be wrongly buried
definition: <kivui>, be buried, and <khial>, by mistake, written as one word
{Kivui}, be buried, with the noun suffix <na>: the place where someone is buried, usually followed by <mun>, place, or <han>, tomb.
<kivui>, be buried, with the closing particle <ta> written as one word: has now been buried, mostly at the end of a headline; the place takes <ah>
Passive of <vuk>, cover, with the prefix <ki>: be covered over with earth; {kivuk dim}, said of a valley, is be filled up.

terms: be filled up/be blocked up/be buried
definition: {Kivuk}, be covered, with <cip>, completely: of a valley, be filled or blocked up; the English of this verse follows another reading.
{Kivuk}, be covered, with <dim>, full: said of a valley filled up with earth.
of water, blood or another liquid: gather and stand on the ground or a floor, as in {tui kivung}, water lies in pools, there is standing flood water
Passive of <za>, hear, with the prefix <ki>: of a sound, voice or cry, be heard; {awging kiza} is a sound is heard.
of news rather than of a sound: be heard of, be reported; it closes a news sentence after <cih> or {cih thu}, and {cih kiza hi} is it is reported that
<zadah>, dislike, with the prefix <ki>: be disliked by people, be found offensive; often with <mahmah>, very much
be held in respect, often as {kizah tak}; the same as <kizahtak>
Passive of <zahhuaisak>, put to shame, with the prefix <ki>.
Passive of <zahko>, mock, with the prefix <ki>: have insults thrown at one.
{Zahkona}, ridicule, with the prefix <ki>: the state of being mocked, or the insulting of one another.

terms: mock one another/look down on one another
definition: <zahpih>, mock, with the prefix <ki>: mock or despise one another, and with <ei leh ei> look down on oneself
Passive of <zahtak>, respect, with the prefix <ki>: of a person or a name, be held in honor; {hong kizahtak mahmah} is highly esteemed.
<zahtak>, respect, with <ki> meaning each other and not the passive: people show respect to one another, mostly after {khat le khat}, one another
{Kizahtak}, be respected, with <bawl>, treat: be treated with honor by others.
{Kizahtak}, be respected, with the linking ending <in>: being respected, followed by another verb.
The fear or respect in which someone is held; {Topa a kizahtakna} is the fear of the Lord, and {khat leh khat kizahtakna} is respect for one another.
<kizahtak> with <siam>, know how to, and the noun ending {-na}: knowing how to respect one another

terms: be photographed/be filmed/be recorded/take a photo
definition: the prefix <ki> with <zaih>, take a picture: a photo, video or X-ray is taken, or people take a picture of themselves, as in {Selfie kizaih}

terms: like a filming/as if being filmed
definition: <kizaih>, be filmed, and <dan>, manner, written as one word, with a following <in>: as the filming of something, in the way a show is filmed
<kizaih>, be photographed or recorded on film, and the future marker <ding> written as one word: to take a photograph or selfie, to be filmed
<kizaih>, take a picture or be filmed, and <in> written as one word: while taking a picture, or was filmed and

terms: be caught on camera/be filmed/be recorded
definition: of an event: be recorded on video or photographed as it happens, usually by chance; from <zaih>, film or photograph, with the prefix {ki-} and <kha>, happen to

terms: take a photo together/be photographed together
definition: <kizaih>, have a picture taken, with <khawm>, together, written as one word: people take a photo or selfie together
<kizaih>, be photographed or filmed, and <khop>, together, written as one word: have a photo taken or be filmed together with someone or something
the taking of a picture or recording of someone by camera or machine, as a selfie, a video or a medical scan

terms: be photographed at once/be filmed at once
definition: <kizaih>, be photographed or filmed, and <pah>, at once, written as one word

terms: have a photo taken with/take a photo together with
definition: <kizaih>, be photographed, with <pih>, together with, written as one word: have a picture taken together with someone or something
